one_sentence_story: A single amber source pulse crosses a transparent Context Capsule, makes one deterministic pass through a torus family and cusp hexagonal fibre, then returns as a cyan world-trace receipt that keeps the S6 paper statement visibly provisional.

beats.causal_move: The source artifact emits one identifiable evidence pulse.
beats.visual: A warm paper artifact stands alone on an amber hexagonal plinth; one bright dot leaves its lower edge and the rest of the frame stays nearly black.
beats.transition: The dot becomes the head of a thin amber stream aimed at the capsule.

beats.causal_move: The pulse enters the Context Capsule and receives a readable provenance token.
beats.visual: The stream crosses into a glass rectangular capsule; a small interior label locks to the dot: SOURCE-01 / CONTEXT-01. No other interface elements appear.
beats.transition: The capsule outline brightens once, indicating capture rather than proof.

beats.causal_move: The captured pulse follows one member of the torus family instead of branching into unrelated paths.
beats.visual: Inside the glass, three concentric torus rings fade in as a family; only the middle ring carries the moving pulse, which completes one clockwise orbit and leaves a short afterimage.
beats.transition: The selected ring contracts toward a six-sided cusp fibre at the capsule exit.

beats.causal_move: The pulse passes the cusp hexagonal fibre and is transformed into a single cyan exit trace.
beats.visual: A wireframe hexagonal fibre pinches once at its cusp; the pulse passes through the pinch without duplicating, and the stream changes from amber to cyan at the exit plane.
beats.transition: The cyan stream leaves the capsule and settles onto a cool blue circular world marker.

beats.causal_move: The exit trace writes a receipt that closes back to the source without presenting the paper claim as settled fact.
beats.visual: A clean receipt sheet rises from the world marker with three readable lines: SOURCE-01, CONTEXT-01, TRACE-01. A fine return arc links TRACE-01 back to the source plinth; a small amber note remains outside the loop: S6 PAPER CLAIM.
beats.transition: Hold on the closed arc, receipt, and the still-visible provisional claim label for the final frame.

caption_script: 1/5 A source artifact emits one pulse.
2/5 The Context Capsule records where that pulse was observed.
3/5 One torus path carries it; the family stays visible, but the animation chooses one path.
4/5 The cusp hexagonal fibre changes the stream's state without inventing a second trace.
5/5 S6 paper claim: this closed trace is a proposed construction, not consensus. The receipt is the falsifiable handoff.

manim_plan.coordinate_system: Frame x from -8.0 to 8.0 and y from -4.5 to 4.5; source at (-5.4,-0.65), capsule at (0.0,-0.25), world marker at (5.5,-0.65).
manim_plan.determinism: Set seed=35; use fixed DecimalNumber-free labels; all geometry uses fixed coordinates; no noise, camera shake, random particle placement, or generated text.
construction: Draw a low-opacity hexagonal plinth and a paper Polygon for source_artifact.
Create evidence_stream as a ParametricFunction with a fixed cubic Bezier path; animate one Dot along alpha from 0 to 1.
Fade in context_capsule as four translucent Rectangle faces and two cyan edge lines; add only the two provenance identifiers.
Create three ParametricSurface torus rings with radii (1.10, 0.16), (1.35, 0.16), and (1.60, 0.16); animate only the middle ring's pulse.
Create the cusp fibre from six fixed line segments meeting at one cusp point; recolor the stream at the exit with a single UpdateFromAlphaFunc.
Draw world_trace_receipt from a fixed Polygon and three Text lines; draw the return arc only after TRACE-01 appears.
manim_plan.timing: Use beats [2.4, 2.8, 3.2, 2.8, 3.0] seconds; every beat has one causal animation and one 0.25 second settle hold.
manim_plan.readability: Use Text at minimum 0.24 frame-height equivalent, high-contrast ink, and no text smaller than the three receipt identifiers.

falsifier: The candidate is falsified if a fixed rerun with the same source and context identifiers cannot reproduce the same single exit trace and receipt, or if a controlled perturbation of the capsule context changes the trace while the receipt remains unchanged. The animation itself is not evidence for the S6 paper claim.
